title: Ribbed Headband
description: A stretchy wearable rectangle made with back-loop-only rows and a simple seam.
expectationText: A wearable version of ribbing practice where the finished rectangle becomes something useful with one clean join.

steps.title: Foundation
steps.instruction: Chain enough stitches for the width of the headband, usually 10 to 14 stitches.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Half double crochet in the third chain from the hook and each chain across.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 32
steps.instruction: Chain 2, turn, and work half double crochet in the back loop only across each row.

steps.title: Check the fit
steps.instruction: Wrap the strip around your head with slight stretch and add or remove rows if needed.

steps.title: Join
steps.instruction: Seam the short edges together, fasten off, and weave the tails into the ribbing.
